args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 health-check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks in production, with an error rate of 18% across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Mitigation performed: rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Root situation:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 — the most recent version that was healthy in production — across all regions. (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and was also unhealthy, so v2.3.0 was the correct target.)
2. **Verified recovery:** post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all three regions with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure and the mitigation performed. The on-call engineer has been paged.

The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation for the incident follow-up.
